gloss: to get along well; to hit it off

definitions.gloss: to get along well; to hit it off; to be on the same wavelength
definitions.explanation: Of two people: to have temperaments that suit each other, so that they get along easily. The image is of a rider and horse moving well together.

examples.english: He and I hit it off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧はどう⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}わない。
examples.english: I just don't get along with my new boss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正反対|せいはんたい}→正反対：14724_seihantai⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}って、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{二十年|にじゅうねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Though their personalities are complete opposites, the two somehow get along, and they have been friends for twenty years now.

notes:
The partner is marked with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}う. The negative {馬|うま}が{合|あ}わない is just as common, for someone one simply cannot get along with.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}う: to get along with ~
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}わない: somehow we just don't click
- ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{馬|うま}が{合|あ}う: to get along for no obvious reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}が{合|あ}う→気が合う：22839_kigaau⟧: to get along — nearly the same; {馬|うま}が{合|あ}う is a little more colloquial and stresses an instinctive fit
- ⟦{相性|あいしょう}がいい→相性がいい：22113_aishougaii⟧: to be compatible — also for things, and for romantic couples
- ⟦{意気投合|いきとうごう}→意気投合：06392_ikitougou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hit it off at once — about a first meeting
